lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Prince.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I have a question.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: For a few days now, I've been receiving notifications on my phone which are decidedly not beautiful.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Do you know how I can fix this?
What kind of notifications?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Hold on.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I'll copy and paste the message for you:

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Your storage space is running out. Please free up some space to avoid potential issues with saving data and files.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: That's what it says.
What have you been doing to use up so much storage?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: What could I possibly do to have done that?
That's true. I don't see you as the type to play mobile games.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: That's correct.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: The most I've done is take a few pictures of myself.
Pictures?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I asked Grave to take them for me.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Of course,

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I look wonderful no matter how the photo is taken,

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: but there are some angles that are more flattering.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: So we've been practicing how to take beautiful pictures together.
Exactly how many photos have you taken?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I'm not sure.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Maybe about 500 photos a day?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: The ones that Grave took, at least.
You mean there are others?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Whenever I take a selfie, they capture my beauty exceptionally well.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: If I add those, I'd say I have about 1,000 photos in total?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Being able to capture beautiful moments in beautiful ways is a beautiful thing,

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: so I've been working hard on capturing those moments.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: However, static pictures weren't enough,

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: so I started recording videos as well.
Why are you recording videos?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: To leave behind beautiful moments.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Grave also likes it when I send them to her.
I'd suggest erasing some of those photos and videos.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: They are filled with my beauty, so shouldn't I treasure them forever?
I think they're the reason why your phone is out of space.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Do you think so?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Is there any way to increase the storage?
There is, but it would take some time.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Then I guess there's nothing I can do.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Grave will be devastated if I delete my beautiful photos and videos.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I suppose I'll just have to tell her to see me more often in person.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Thanks, Prince.
Right...
